The script sink requires t=p and a b parameter, converts PRTime to Date, awaits RNP.verifyDetached and passes the result to existing security status handling. The C++ caller obtains a Promise but does not attach completion/rejection handling in this inspected scope. Buffer collection is synchronous; cryptographic engine internals, URI/result staleness and rejection effects remain bounded.",
